boundary.deletedHistory: Deleted or non-existent historical AI conversations are NOT classified as trade secrets because the information is no longer retained.
boundary.publicInformation: Information intentionally published in public repositories or the public catalogue is not classified here as secret information.
boundary.survivingPrivateKnowhow: Only surviving non-public information may be treated as confidential or as trade-secret information where the applicable legal criteria are satisfied.
boundary.legalOpinion: This register is an internal classification and does not constitute an independent legal opinion.

protectedCategories: non-public prompt and iteration strategies that still exist
